description: Interface definition for ISimplePersistentGrain, extending ISimpleGrain with methods for setting data, retrieving version, request context, and setting request context.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets an integer value and a deactivate flag.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version as a GUID.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current request context object.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Sets the request context with provided data.
